message.locatorhud.coordinates_unavailab: Coordinates are not available to copy
message.locatorhud.coordinates_restricte: Coordinates are unavailable while the server limits debug information
screen.locatorhud.title: 1MB Locator HUD
screen.locatorhud.panel_placement.title: Place Locator HUD panels
screen.locatorhud.panel_placement.help: Drag an outlined panel; it snaps to a corner with a small offset.
tooltip.locatorhud.enabled: Show or hide the entire Locator HUD. You can also use the Locator HUD key binding (F7 by default).
tooltip.locatorhud.accessibility_setting: Expose 110%, 125%, and 150% panel sizes plus expanded keyboard and narrator guidance. Turning this off returns sizes above 100% to 100%. Colors and backgrounds remain independently configurable.
tooltip.locatorhud.preset: Choose a fixed Minimal, Explorer, Builder, or Privacy setup. Presets use existing settings and remain fully editable after applying.
tooltip.locatorhud.apply_preset: Apply the selected preset to HUD content, sizes, and backgrounds. Your manual color choice, biome-aware color override, panel positions and width limits, shadows, and copy format are kept.
tooltip.locatorhud.save_setup: Save all current Locator HUD settings to the single local Saved setup slot. Replacing an existing saved setup requires confirmation.
tooltip.locatorhud.restore_setup: Replace all current settings with the local Saved setup. This action requires confirmation.
tooltip.locatorhud.edit_panel_placement: Open the live placement editor. Drag either panel near a screen corner; offsets are snapped and limited so panels remain recoverable.
tooltip.locatorhud.palette: Choose the color scheme used by both HUD panels.
narration.locatorhud.biome_theme_overrid: Biome-aware colors. When checked, HUD colors change smoothly with the local biome and underground environment.
tooltip.locatorhud.text_shadow: Add a shadow behind HUD text to improve readability.
tooltip.locatorhud.panel_shadow: Add a shadow behind panel backgrounds. Requires an enabled panel with a background.
tooltip.locatorhud.panel_shadow_disabled: Panel shadow is unavailable because no enabled panel has a visible background. Enable a panel and choose a background other than OFF.
tooltip.locatorhud.main_panel_enabled: Show or hide the main panel.
tooltip.locatorhud.position: Choose the screen corner used by the main panel and clear its fine offset. Use Place panels for direct dragging.
tooltip.locatorhud.coordinate_display: Choose whether to show XYZ, block coordinates, both, or neither. Coordinate rows are hidden while the server limits debug information.
tooltip.locatorhud.decimal_precision: Choose the XYZ precision. None rounds values to whole numbers. Available when Coordinate display includes XYZ or the coordinate lens is on.
tooltip.locatorhud.decimal_precision_dis: Decimal precision is unavailable. Set Coordinate display to include XYZ or turn on the OW / Nether lens.
tooltip.locatorhud.world_name: Show the world or dimension name before or after coordinates, or hide it.
tooltip.locatorhud.coordinate_lens: Show approximate X/Z coordinates for the corresponding Nether or Overworld location. Uses Decimal precision. This does not indicate a portal or safe destination and is hidden while the server limits debug information.
tooltip.locatorhud.coordinate_copy_forma: Choose what the Copy coordinates key (F8 by default) places on the clipboard: plain coordinates, a namespaced vanilla self-teleport command, or a CMI tppos template. Nothing is run or sent, and copying is refused while the server limits debug information. CMI uses the client-known dimension path, which may need editing if the server uses a different world name.
tooltip.locatorhud.view_direction: Show a four-way cardinal direction, add eight-way direction and axis details, or hide the direction. View angles are controlled separately.
tooltip.locatorhud.view_angles: Show yaw and pitch on the view row. The cardinal direction is controlled separately.
tooltip.locatorhud.angle_decimals: Choose yaw and pitch precision. Off shows whole degrees. Available when View angles is on.
tooltip.locatorhud.angle_decimals_disabl: Angle decimals is unavailable because View angles is off. Turn on View angles to change this setting.
tooltip.locatorhud.hud_size: Choose the display size of the main panel.
tooltip.locatorhud.background: Choose the opacity of the main panel background. Off uses a compact backgroundless layout.
tooltip.locatorhud.details_panel_enabled: Show or hide the details and target panel.
tooltip.locatorhud.details_position: Choose the screen corner used by the details panel and clear its fine offset. Use Place panels for direct dragging.
tooltip.locatorhud.biome: Show the biome at your current position.
tooltip.locatorhud.biome_transition: Briefly show the previous and current biome for 3 seconds after you cross a biome boundary. Uses only the biome at your position.
tooltip.locatorhud.movement_speed: Show smoothed horizontal movement speed in blocks per second. This is observed locally and does not read or change CMI speed.
tooltip.locatorhud.target_block: Show the block targeted by your crosshair. Target details are hidden while the server limits debug information.
tooltip.locatorhud.target_fluid: Show the fluid targeted by your crosshair. Target details are hidden while the server limits debug information.
tooltip.locatorhud.target_entity: Show the entity targeted by your crosshair. Target details are hidden while the server limits debug information.
tooltip.locatorhud.target_name_mode: Choose localized Friendly names or full namespaced API accurate identifiers for block, fluid, and entity targets.
tooltip.locatorhud.auto_hide_empty_value: Hide empty block, fluid, and entity target rows until a target is found. Target linger may delay hiding briefly.
tooltip.locatorhud.target_linger: Keep the last non-empty target values visible for 0.5 seconds after the crosshair moves away.
tooltip.locatorhud.details_size: Choose the display size of the details panel.
tooltip.locatorhud.details_background: Choose the opacity of the details panel background. Off uses a compact backgroundless layout.
tooltip.locatorhud.minimum_width: Set the panel's base minimum width before Size scaling. Auto follows its content. The current screen can reduce the result so the panel remains recoverable.
tooltip.locatorhud.maximum_width: Set the panel's base maximum width before Size scaling. Auto follows its content. Long names are shortened where possible, and the current screen remains the final limit.
tooltip.locatorhud.reset: Restore factory defaults after confirmation. The separate Saved setup is not changed.
tooltip.locatorhud.done: Return to the previous screen. Changes are saved automatically.
tooltip.locatorhud.reset_positions: Restore the main panel to Top / Left and the details panel to Top / Right with zero fine offsets. Other settings are unchanged.
tooltip.locatorhud.panel_placement_done: Save the final panel positions and return to Locator HUD settings.
narration.locatorhud.config_usage: Use Tab and Shift plus Tab to move between settings. Press Enter or Space to change a choice. On sliders, press Enter or Space, then use Left and Right Arrow to move one stop.
confirm.locatorhud.reset.title: Reset Locator HUD?
confirm.locatorhud.reset.message: This replaces all current settings with factory defaults. Your separate Saved setup is not changed.
confirm.locatorhud.restore_setup.title: Restore Saved setup?
confirm.locatorhud.restore_setup.message: This replaces all current settings with the values in your local Saved setup slot.
confirm.locatorhud.overwrite_setup.title: Replace Saved setup?
confirm.locatorhud.overwrite_setup.messa: This overwrites the existing Saved setup with all current Locator HUD settings.
